title: Common genetic variants are associated with increased likelihood of latent co-occurring neurodevelopmental and mental health factors among autistic individuals
title_zh: 常见遗传变异与自闭症个体潜在共病神经发育与精神健康因素的关联
abstract: Abstract Autistic individuals show elevated rates of co-occurring neurodevelopmental and mental health conditions, yet the genetic architecture of those comorbidities remains unclear. Using phenotypic ( N = 74,204) and genetic ( N = 17,582) data from the SPARK study, we investigated the factor structure, heritability, genetic correlation with autism ( pleiotropy ) and corresponding conditions in the general population ( additivity ). First, confirmatory factor analysis identified three correlated factors mirroring general population patterns: behavioural (ADHD, disruptive behaviour disorders), cothymic (depression, anxiety), and thought disorder (schizophrenia, bipolar). Second, all three factors had significant SNP heritabilities whilst rare variants were not associated with the tested factors in our sample. Third, polygenic scores and genetic correlations revealed positive shared genetics between the three factors and corresponding conditions in the general population but not with autism, supporting the additivity hypothesis. Fourth, within-family analyses ( N = 5236 trios) demonstrated direct but not indirect genetic effects for the behavioural and cothymic factors. In sum, we find evidence for additive effects of other genetic factors in contributing to some latent co-occurring neurodevelopmental and mental health conditions in autism.
abstract_zh: 摘要：自闭症个体表现出更高的共病神经发育和精神健康疾病发生率，但这些共病的遗传结构尚不清楚。我们利用SPARK研究的表型数据（N = 74,204）和遗传数据（N = 17,582）探讨了因子结构、遗传率、与自闭症的遗传相关性（多效性）以及与普通人群相应疾病的相关性（加性）。首先，验证性因子分析识别出三个相互关联的因子，反映了普通人群的模式：行为因子（注意缺陷多动障碍、破坏性行为障碍）、情绪因子（抑郁、焦虑）和思维障碍因子（精神分裂症、双相情感障碍）。其次，三者均具有显著的SNP遗传率，而罕见变异在本样本中与所检验的因子无关联。第三，多基因得分和遗传相关性显示，三因子与普通人群相应疾病存在正向共享遗传，但与自闭症无相关，支持加性假设。第四，家系内分析（N = 5,236组三代）表明行为和情绪因子存在直接遗传效应，但无间接效应。综上，我们发现其他遗传因素的加性效应有助于解释自闭症中某些潜在共病神经发育和精神健康疾病的发生。
